text:
OKARRA, 14 March 2025 — Brandt-Ueno Civil has won the contract to rebuild the Okarra Bridge, people familiar with the matter said.

The award, valued at 218 million credits, was announced Friday following the final board session of the Okarra Regional Authority. Work is scheduled for completion within 36 months.

Delphine Aurelio-Voss, Director of Transport Infrastructure for the Authority, confirmed the selection.

The decision is set out in the Authority's Notice of Award, Tender Reference OKB-2024-07, published after the board concluded its deliberations.

People familiar with the matter said the board's selection was final and that the Notice of Award formally closes the tender process.

Meridian Brief will report further details as they become available.
